question.text: Annexure 3 Row 16 requires disclosure of 'Social Intent of the NPO (Specify the Sub-clause(s) of Regulation ___ of ICDR Regulations along with Clarifications)'. What is the correct Regulation and sub-clause reference?

explanation.text: The Logic: Annexure 3 Row 16 of the workbook references Regulation 292E(2)(a) of the ICDR Regulations as the source for the NPO's social-intent sub-clauses to be disclosed along with clarifications. The Annexure 3 disclosure requirement is the basis for the keyed answer. The Trap: Reg 33 is the LODR financial-results regulation and Section 135 is the Companies Act CSR provision (not an ICDR Regulation). 292A is a different SSE provision. Only 292E(2)(a) matches the Annexure 3 cross-reference. Note: When completing Annexure 3 Row 16, list each 292E(2)(a) sub-clause separately with the supporting clarification, so the SIA can map the disclosure back to the workbook reference during review.
